diagnosisNoRules: No proxy rules yet — create one first.
diagnosisProxyDisabled: The proxy master switch is off, so no rule takes effect. Turn it on.
diagnosisRuleNotApplied: The matched rule “$1” uses the network-layer channel, but Chrome will not apply it: switch to wildcard or prefix matching.
diagnosisPageNotSynced: Rule “$1” is fine, but this page is still running the rules from before your change — reload it.
diagnosisShadowedBy: Rule “$1” does cover this address, but the higher-priority “$2” takes the match: separate their priorities.
diagnosisDisabledMatch: Rule “$1” matches this address, but it is currently off — enable it.
diagnosisMethodFiltered: Rule “$1” matches this address, but it only handles $2, and this request's method is not in that list.
diagnosisPatternRejected: Rule “$1” has a pattern that was rejected (invalid regex syntax or catastrophic backtracking risk), so it never matches. Rewrite the pattern.
diagnosisNoMatch: No rule's pattern covers this address.
diagnosisOkDnr: This request matches rule “$1” and will be rewritten by the network-layer channel.
diagnosisOkSw: This request matches rule “$1” and will be forwarded by the proxy channel.
